site.name: Paccradle
site.title: Paccradle: box inserts from one photo
site.description: Put your product on A4 or Letter paper, take one photo, and get a cut-ready box insert plus a matching box. Check the fit in 3D, then export SVG, PDF or DXF.
footer.tagline: Box inserts that fit, from one photo.
footer.paddle: Payments are processed by Paddle.com, our merchant of record.
hero.title: Snap your product. Get a box insert that fits it.
hero.title.line2: Get a box insert that fits your
hero.lead: Put your product on a sheet of A4 or Letter paper and take one photo. Paccradle measures it, designs an insert that holds it, sizes a matching box, and shows you the fit in 3D before you print.
hero.note: Design and preview for free. Pay only when you download production files.
hero.illustration: An unfolded cradle insert on a sheet of paper: cut lines solid, fold lines dashed, three bottle holes with fit rings. Its walls fold up and down.
hero.caption: Cradle insert · 3 × 30 ml · E-flute
marquee.label: What people pack, and what they cut it with
demo.title: See it work
demo.lead: Photo to insert in about a minute.
how.title: How it works
how.lead: From a photo to files your printer can cut.
how.step1.title: Take one photo on paper
how.step1.body: Put your product on A4 or US Letter paper and photograph it from above. The paper is the ruler. For the most exact fit, trace around the product with a pen and photograph the outline instead.
how.step2.title: Pick an insert
how.step2.body: Choose a partition grid, a cutout card or a raised cradle, and your board: paperboard, chipboard or corrugated. A matching mailer or shipping box is sized for you.
how.step3.title: Check the fit, then export
how.step3.body: Watch it fold in 3D with every hole colored by clearance. Print a free test on your home printer, then download cut-ready SVG, PDF or DXF files.
features.title: Everything you need to get it made
features.inserts.title: Three insert styles
features.inserts.body: Partition grids for rows of bottles and jars, cutout cards for tubes and small items, and cradle platforms for premium bottles.
features.box.title: A matching outer box
features.box.body: A mailer or shipping box sized around your insert, with inside and outside measurements.
features.fit.title: 3D fold and fit check
features.fit.body: Know it fits before you pay a printer.
features.test.title: Free print-at-home test
features.test.body: Your insert tiled across A4 or Letter sheets with alignment marks, so you can build a paper prototype in minutes.
features.files.title: Production files
features.files.body: Separate cut and crease layers, for printers, die makers, lasers, CNC tables and Cricut.
features.checks.title: Built-in checks
features.checks.body: Warnings for holes too close to an edge or a fold, slots that don't match your board, and pieces too big for your sheet.

faq.title: Questions
faq.export.a: Downloading the production files (SVG, PDF and DXF) for one design. Previews and the watermarked test PDF are always free.
faq.edit.q: Can I change a design after paying?
faq.edit.a: Yes. You can edit an unlocked design for 30 days and download its files again at any time.
faq.paddle.a: Paddle.com is our merchant of record. Paddle handles the payment, sales tax and receipts.
faq.refund.a: Yes. The Refund Policy explains how and when.

capture.rail.label: Steps
capture.mode.title: How shall we measure it?
capture.mode.lead: Pick the way that suits your product. You can switch at any time.
capture.mode.photo.title: Photo on paper
capture.mode.photo.body: Stand the product on A4 or Letter paper and take one photo from above. Best for flat and low products.
capture.mode.trace.body: Draw round the product with a pen, take it away, then photograph the line. No size error, even for tall bottles.
capture.mode.trace.title: Trace on paper
capture.mode.typed.title: Type the sizes
capture.mode.typed.body: Already know it? Enter the size from a ruler or the spec sheet: round or rectangular, plus the height.
capture.setup.lead: A minute of setup gives a fit to the millimetre.
capture.paper.title: Your paper
capture.paper.note: The paper is the ruler: its known size turns pixels into millimetres. Use a clean, flat sheet.
capture.pen.title: Your pen's line
capture.pen.note: We measure from the inside of the line and add back half its width. A fine felt-tip is about 0.5 mm.
capture.tips.title: For the best photo
capture.tip.corners.title: All four corners
capture.tip.corners.body: Lay the paper on a darker table so it stands out, with every corner in the photo.
capture.tip.centre.title: Product in the middle
capture.tip.centre.body: Keep it at least 2 cm from every edge of the paper.
capture.tip.height.title: High and level
capture.tip.height.body: Hold the phone about 50 cm up, straight above, and zoom to 2×.
capture.tip.light.title: Soft light
capture.tip.light.body: Daylight from a window or the side. Avoid hard shadows and flash.
capture.tip.colour.title: White or clear product?
capture.tip.colour.body: Use coloured paper so it stands out, or switch to Trace mode.
capture.tip.trace.title: Draw round it
capture.tip.trace.body: Hold the pen upright and trace close to the product's base, in one closed line.
capture.tip.remove.title: Take the product away
capture.tip.remove.body: Photograph just the paper and your line. Nothing else on the sheet.
capture.tip.traceHeight.body: Hold the phone straight above the paper and zoom to 2×.
capture.photo.title: Add your photo
capture.photo.lead: Take it now with your phone, or use one you already have.
capture.photo.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP. HEIC works in Safari.
capture.photo.heic: This browser can't open HEIC photos. Send it as a JPEG (on iPhone: Settings › Camera › Formats › Most Compatible), or use Safari.
capture.photo.unreadable: We couldn't open this file as a photo. Try a JPEG or PNG.
capture.photo.tooSmall: This photo is too small to measure. Use one at least 1000 px on its long side.
capture.measuring.title: Reading your photo
capture.measuring.slow: This is taking longer than usual. It will finish on its own; you can leave this page and come back.
capture.figure.photoAlt: Your photo of the product on paper
capture.figure.outlineAlt: The paper and the product's outline as measured
capture.result.title: Here's your product
capture.result.lastKept: Your last outline is kept below.
capture.action.trace: Use Trace mode for an exact fit
capture.action.tapProduct: Tap your product on the photo
capture.fail.tapLead: Is your product in the photo? Tap it and we'll look right there.
capture.missing.title: This measurement isn't here
capture.missing.lead: It may belong to another account or browser. Start a new one: it takes a minute.
capture.typed.title: Type the sizes
capture.typed.lead: Measure from above with a ruler or calliper. Round things need just the diameter.
capture.typed.heightHint: Standing as it sits in the box, cap included.
capture.check.label: Check the outline
capture.check.title: Is the line right?
capture.check.lead: The terracotta line should hug your product's base. If it doesn't, fix it here.
capture.tool.tapNoPhoto: Needs the photo, which isn't shown here
capture.tool.adjustHint: An edge is a little off
capture.tap.instruction: Tap your product on the photo. We'll measure again and keep the outline under your tap.
capture.tap.offPaper: That's off the paper. Tap on your product, inside the sheet.
capture.adjust.editorLabel: The outline's points. Use [ and ] to pick a point, the arrow keys to move it (Shift moves it faster), Delete to remove it.
capture.adjust.crosses: The line crosses itself. Move the points so it goes round the product once.
capture.adjust.tooSmall: This outline is too small to measure (under {min} mm²). Move the points further apart.
capture.adjust.howTo: Drag a point to move it, or drag the line to add one. Points stay on the paper.
capture.adjust.keys: Double-click a point to remove it. Keys: [ ] pick a point · arrows move it · Delete removes it · ⌘Z undo.
capture.adjust.saved: Saved. We measured your outline exactly as you drew it.
warning.tall_product_looks_bigger: From above, a tall product's top looks bigger than it is. Add its height next to see by how much, or use Trace mode for an exact fit.
warning.outline_may_be_bigger: At {height_mm} mm tall, the outline may reach up to {up_to_mm} mm past the real edge. Trace mode gives an exact fit.
warning.touches_paper_edge: The product touches the paper's edge. Move it to the middle, at least 2 cm from the edges, and retake.
warning.other_objects.one: There's 1 other object on the paper. Remove it, or check the outline is the right one.
warning.other_objects.other: There are {count} other objects on the paper. Remove them, or check the outline is the right one.
warning.low_confidence: We're not fully sure of this outline. Check it, or retake in softer light.
capture.next.lead: Add the height, how many go in a box, and the insert and box to hold them.
choices.title: Build your insert
choices.lead: Pick how the insert holds your product and the box around it. The preview redraws as you choose.
choices.section.product.lead: Its height, and how many go in one box.
choices.section.insert.lead: Three ways to keep products still in the box.
choices.section.board.lead: What the insert is cut from. Each edge is drawn to scale.
choices.section.box.lead: Sized round the insert, with a little room on each side.
choices.height.label: Height (mm)
choices.height.hint: Standing as it sits in the box, cap included.
choices.height.invalid: Type a height from {min} to {max} mm.
choices.height.checking: Checking the photo for this height…
choices.quantity.label: How many in one box
choices.style.partition_grid.body: Slotted dividers, one cell each. Best for several jars or bottles.
choices.style.cutout_card.body: A flat card with a hole shaped to each product. Best for low items: lipsticks, tubes, jewellery.
choices.style.cradle_platform.body: A raised deck on folded legs. Best for one to a few tall bottles.
choices.style.why.low: suits low, flat products: each sits in its own shaped hole.
choices.style.why.many: suits several of the same item: each gets its own cell.
choices.style.why.tall: suits one to a few tall items: they stand through a raised deck.
choices.grid.title: Grid layout
board.paperboard.use: Folding carton. Crisp print, light items.
board.chipboard.use: Rigid grey board, as in gift boxes.
board.e_flute.use: Thin corrugated. Folds well, prints well.
choices.board.thicknessInvalid: Type a thickness above 0 and up to {max} mm.
choices.board.clearanceHint: Per side. More is easier to lift out; less holds tighter.
choices.board.clearanceInvalid: Type a gap from 0 to {max} mm.
choices.board.printer: These are starting values. Ask your printer for their board's thickness and print a test first.
choices.box.mailer.body: A hinged lid that tucks in. Opens like a gift.
choices.box.shipping.body: The classic carton with four flaps, taped shut.
choices.box.none.body: You already have a box. Just the insert.
choices.name.label: Design name
choices.save.free: Free to design and test-print. You pay only to download production files.
choices.save.cantYet: This combination can't be made yet. Change a choice above.
choices.preview.waiting: Add the product's height to see your insert.

choices.pending.title: Still measuring

choices.unmeasured.title: No outline to design from

choices.nothing.title: Nothing measured yet

preview.cant: This combination can't be made yet. Try another style, board or count.

preview.fit.all.other: All {count} fit, with at least {mm} mm to spare.
